experience.employer: Moody's Analytics - Asset Management & Buy-Side Solutions

sections.heading: Independent Risk Measurement & Assessment
bullets: Holds delegated sign-off authority on valuation and sensitivity outputs for multi-asset institutional portfolios of $5-25bn per engagement (~$50bn+ cumulative), independently reviewing curve construction, spread calibration, and cross-asset interactions before production release.
Validated derivatives pricing outputs across rates, FX, and inflation, confirming consistency of sensitivities and scenario impacts at portfolio-level aggregates.
Serves on the model governance committee, contributing to methodology review, benchmarking and documentation standards, and model-performance assessment for client-delivered analytics.
Reviewed aggregation logic converting security-level exposures into portfolio-level risk metrics feeding downstream risk and capital processes.

sections.heading: Portfolio Stress, Scenario & Liquidity Risk Analysis
bullets: Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios across multi-year horizons.
Architected configurable time-bucketed liquidity gap analytics (T+1 through multi-year), supporting funding, refinancing-risk, and asset-allocation decisions.
Oversaw duration and rate-sensitivity analysis under parallel and non-parallel shocks across multi-asset institutional books.

sections.heading: Risk Oversight, Escalation & Stakeholder Engagement
bullets: Escalated outputs lacking mathematical or economic defensibility and served as escalation point for client-critical analytical issues, interfacing directly with clients' Heads of Risk and investment stakeholders.
Prepared analytical summaries for senior stakeholders covering exposure, scenario impacts, and portfolio sensitivities, translating quantitative output into investment-committee-ready narratives.

Built agentic AI development workflows (Claude Code, Cursor IDE) automating validation scaffolding and anomaly detection in code and model outputs, cutting development cycle time an estimated 30-40% on comparable modules.
Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into scalable Python analytics pipelines with embedded logging, validation, and auditability controls.

Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms migrating to the PFaroe DB (risk & ALM analytics) and PFaroe PM (portfolio management) platforms.

Served as technical liaison between client investment teams and product owners, scoping requirements into development requests and validating model outputs post-deployment; contributed to migrating all assigned accounts off the legacy Calypso platform.

roles.title: Senior Consultant, IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 risk and finance transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients, aligning regulatory requirements with system implementation.
Coordinated across actuarial, finance, IT, risk, and program-management teams on milestone delivery, governance documentation, and readiness processes.

Performed asset-only and asset-liability (surplus) portfolio optimization on VaR and CVaR using Ortec's GLASS platform, with risk decomposition and near-optimal frontier analysis to test the robustness of allocation recommendations.
Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators assessing interest-rate risk and funding volatility under base-case and stressed environments.
Advised institutional clients on strategic and tactical asset allocation trade-offs through stress testing and sensitivity analysis.
Performed cash flow, liquidity, and hedging analysis across interest-rate, inflation, and currency risk for international institutional clients.

Led onboarding and the ALM study for a three-plan university pension merger, on a team of three developing and validating the model capturing all funding-policy dynamics and evaluating duration, currency, inflation, and leverage overlay strategies.
Presented study findings and risk recommendations on-site to investment committees at Canadian pension-fund clients.
